subject: Decision Making
title: Accountability in Automated Decisions
description: One-minute skill: Accountability in Automated Decisions.

hook.text: A self-driving car kills a pedestrian. Who is liable? The programmer, the car company, the owner.

buildup.text: Current legal frameworks assign responsibility to humans. But when AI makes autonomous decisions.

discovery.text: The EU's AI Act creates risk categories. High-risk AI systems need human oversight, logging.

twist.text: Some scholars propose giving AI systems legal personhood. Critics warn this lets corporations hide behind algorithms to.

climax.text: Accountability requires traceability. Every automated decision must have a human who can be held responsible for its.

punchline.text: The algorithm decided. Who is responsible? Someone human must always be.

quiz.question: What does the EU's AI Act require for high-risk AI?
options: Human oversight, decision logging, and the ability to explain individual decisions
